whyMatters.en: LA funk-rock band; Blood Sugar Sex Magik (1991) and Californication (1999) scaled slap bass and Frusciante guitar to global alternative radio.
whyMatters.zh: 洛杉矶 funk-rock；Blood Sugar Sex Magik（1991）与 Californication（1999）把打点贝斯与 Frusciante 吉他扩到全球 alternative 电台。

shortBio.en: Kiedis / Flea / Frusciante funk-alt; Californication is the late-90s mass single.
shortBio.zh: Kiedis / Flea / Frusciante 的 funk-alt；Californication 是 90 年代末大众单曲。

body.en:
Formed 1983. Mother’s Milk and Blood Sugar Sex Magik (Rick Rubin) are the hard-funk peak; Californication and By the Way add melodic ballad craft after lineup churn.

Californication (1999) is the track listed here. The musical constants: Flea’s bass as lead instrument, Chad Smith’s pocket, Frusciante’s clean-to-crunch chord voicings.
body.zh:
1983 年组建。Mother’s Milk 与 Blood Sugar Sex Magik（Rick Rubin）是硬 funk 高峰；Californication 与 By the Way 在阵容动荡后加入旋律谣曲工艺。

Californication（1999）是此处列出曲目。音乐常量：Flea 贝斯当主奏、Chad Smith 的口袋感、Frusciante 从干净到 crunch 的和弦声部。
